newsitem.title: JAPAN: Itochu, Hitachi win China order for nuclear plant.
newsitem.headline: Itochu, Hitachi win China order for nuclear plant.

text.p: Itochu Corp and Hitachi Ltd have received an order for turbines and other equipment for nuclear power plants in China, Itochu said on Friday.
A spokesman for Itochu said, however, that details of the order could not be disclosed immediately.
Japanese business dailies reported on Friday that Hitachi and Itochu have received a two-billion-yen order in a project to build two nuclear power plants located 120 kilometres southwest of Shanghai.
The main contractor in the project is state-owned Atomic Energy of Canada Ltd, the Itochu spokesman said.
The plants are expected to start operating in 2003, the papers said.
As the number of nuclear power plant projects at home is very limited, Japanese companies are attracted to nuclear projects in Asia which are increasing in number.

As of the end of 1995, there were 28 nuclear power plants planned in Asian countries excluding Japan, compared with only two in Japan, according to the Japan Atomic Industrial Forum, a government-affiliated institution.
